verdict.rationale: The evidence documents official TypeScript, Python, and Go SDKs and a way to upload custom MCP server code for hosting. Nothing shows an official Metorial CLI for authenticating, building, pushing, or installing servers into agents. The only mention of 'CLIs' refers to third-party MCP clients connecting through approved access, which is not a Metorial publishing CLI.

support.subject: As a developer, I can drive the publish-and-deploy workflow from an official CLI — authenticate, stage or build a server, push it, and install it into agents
